Orikhiv Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zaporizka oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. According to the Commission on the Preservation of Jewish Heritage (KSEN), this cemetery's tombstones span an unusually recent range for this collection — from 1962 to 1990 — before it was almost completely destroyed by bulldozer sometime between 1986 and 1992. Orikhiv's Jewish community, present since the town's founding in 1801, maintained two cemeteries and suffered pogroms in 1881 and 1919; by 1939 its population had fallen to 358, and most of those who remained were killed in early 1942. A local resident recalled a second Jewish cemetery once located behind the SPD Petrov plant, also demolished sometime in the 1990s.
